desc: The SPD CRUSR Rifle is built for one mission: to deliver a best-in-class feature set for professional guides, backcountry outfitters, and adventurous hunters who push their expeditions deep into the world’s most remote locales. Compact, rugged, and ultralight at just 6.7 lbs. with an overall length of 35.25 inches, the CRUSR gives serious adventure goers a thoroughly modern lever action built to thrive where failure isn’t an option. Chambered in .45-70 Gov’t with a 4+1 capacity, this rifle brings enough proven stopping power for all seven continents.
